capabilities: merge note and same-name folder pairs into single page nodes
create nested pages and folders from a context menu or plus button
move, rename, and delete pages via drag-and-drop, fuzzy Move to, and multi-select
assign per-page icons from built-in sets, emoji, or image URLs
filter the tree by title and follow the active note
extras: Manual install or via BRAT; page icons are stored in frontmatter while folder icons live in plugin data.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer shows a Notion-exported page as two separate entries (Page.md plus a same-name folder), making Notion-shaped vaults painful to navigate.
summary: Notion-style page tree sidebar that merges each note and its same-name folder into one expandable page node with drag-and-drop, icons, and filtering.
